name: matched-chainage benchmark
description: Reproduction bundle for a study of cross-machine transfer of data-driven models between two parallel earth-pressure-balance (EPB) shield drives excavated along matched chainage with different tunnel-boring machines. Contents:- a de-identified 1,000-ring analysis table (outputs/model_dataset.csv) with a variable dictionary (outputs/DATA_CARD.md);- the complete public analysis code and a single driver script that regenerates every computed figure and table;- all machine-readable results, prediction ledgers and fold-audit files;- generated main and supplementary figures;- dated analysis-plan, results and literature-screening records;- an article copy of the manuscript and Supplementary Material (LaTeX sources and PDFs). The analysis covers domain-shift characterisation between the two drives, baseline and transfer models, recalibration and split-conformal prediction intervals, and an internally specified matched-chainage non-inferiority diagnostic with equal-count exposure and alignment sensitivity checks. Code is released under the MIT License; the data table and generated data/result tables under CC BY 4.0 (see DATA_LICENSE.md). Environment and seeds are documented in REPRODUCIBILITY.md; SHA256SUMS carries a checksum for every file. This version is anonymized for double-anonymized peer review. Author and affiliation metadata will be added after peer review; the record already has a versioned DOI.
